prompt:
Create a photorealistic isolated catalog image of the exact white BMW G20 first-facelift ordinary Basic-version four-door sedan in the supplied licensed photograph. It represents the standard-wheelbase 2022–2024 body, with a separate boot. Use a new, coherent whole-vehicle camera with a balanced front three-quarter 1/2 view, nose pointing right. Show both headlamps, the full grille and front bumper, and a substantial length of the visible side. Rotate the whole vehicle consistently; do not keep the near-head-on camera or rotate only its nose.

Preserve the actual white gloss paint, white plain mirror caps and black bases, body-coloured handles, black window trim, and silver radial Y-spoke alloy wheels with BMW centre roundels and complete tyres. Keep the actual front parking-sensor circles, large chrome kidney outlines with black internal vertical bars, blue-and-white bonnet roundel, flat first-facelift headlamps with their actual inner angular light shapes, and ordinary Basic bumper with a long horizontal-bar lower central opening and black triangular outer ears. Do not substitute the M Sport hexagonal lower grille, chin, wheel design or side badges. Do not turn it into a long-wheelbase G28, an earlier G20 or the later second facelift. No charging port or power badge should be invented.

The actual roof profile is plain white metal with no independently resolved target fin, rod, rails or sunroof. Keep that visible outline without adding a brand-default fin or copying the factory brochure accessory height into a self-occluded view. The neighbouring blue car and black BMW i3, including their mirrors and accessories, are background only. The photograph is the sole generation input; commercial catalogue and manufacturer pictures are identity evidence only.

Remove the identifiable trees, buildings, signs, people, parked cars and ground, including their recognisable reflections on the body and glass. Preserve the actual white colour and gloss material, using only simple soft studio highlights and a natural unobtrusive interior; shape and equipment fidelity does not require copying the original environment mapping. Clean rain spots, dirt and minor surface blemishes without changing physical trim. Use a blank neutral number plate, retaining manufacturer emblems.

Return a true transparent RGBA PNG. Keep the complete vehicle, tyres, mirrors, bumpers and roof inside generous transparent margins of at least 100 pixels on every side, including the bottom. There must be no floor, contact shadow, reflection below the vehicle, glow, halo, coloured fringe or detached alpha specks. Use a clean finely antialiased outline without cropping or stretching the car.
